Package index

Overview

stacserver stacserver-package
stacserver: Serve SpatioTemporal Asset Catalogs over a STAC API

Database Backend

Set up and manage a PostgreSQL/PostGIS database backing store for STAC Collections and Items.

stac_db_setup()
Create the STAC database schema
stac_db_insert_collection()
Insert or update a STAC Collection in the database
stac_db_insert_item()
Insert or update a STAC Item in the database
stac_db_delete_collection()
Delete a STAC Collection and all its items from the database
stac_db_delete_item()
Delete a STAC Item from the database

STAC API Server

Serve a STAC API 1.0 compliant HTTP API via plumber, backed by the PostgreSQL database.

stac_api_router()
Create a plumber router serving a minimal STAC API

Asset Signing

Rewrite asset hrefs into short-lived signed URLs for private object storage on Azure Blob Storage. Pass the result to stac_api_router(sign_fn = ).

azure_signer()
Create a reusable Azure Blob Storage signing function
